Our two recent articles on spatial audio drew plenty of comments, and the point readers raised most often was this: what spatial audio lacks most is content.

Fanyu Meng: What is spatial sound?

Fanyu Meng: Google and Samsung take on Dolby Atmos, with a little help from aespa

So what does spatial audio actually sound like? Here are two pieces by an immersive audio producer from Nanjing. Put on headphones before you press play.

Creator’s note: “Piano Solo in a Concert Hall” makes deliberate use of two propagation cues, distance differences and intensity differences. It combines the ambience of the hall with the solo piano as a sound object to build one complete soundscape. Listening to it, I feel thoroughly at ease and relaxed.

Creator’s note: “A Music Café by the Road” was inspired by a corner coffee shop in my city. The music playing inside and the sounds of the barista at work form the immersive bed, with a series of sound objects layered on top, to recreate a warm, cozy afternoon on that street corner.

About the creator:

Zhen Shen

  • Sound designer and film re-recording mixer
  • Many years of professional experience in audio engineering and sound creation
  • Intermediate-level Multimedia Designer qualification from China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
  • Developer of the MSAH immersive audio workflow

Selected work

1. Experience creating audio-visual content in surround sound, 3D audio and immersive media (VR and blended projection). Founded an internet radio station in 2007 and, in 2014, Yuedong Shitingshi, a podcast devoted to immersive sound technology, releasing numerous works in MSAH binaural, Dolby Atmos and Sennheiser 3D Audio formats.

2. Produced immersive audio for a series of panoramic city tours, released on interactive new-media platforms.

3. In 2019, sole sound designer and final mixer for the theatrical feature film Yaogun Shaonian zhi Quanmin Yuedui (roughly, “Rock Kids: A Band for Everyone”), which passed China’s film review and received its public screening license. The film was featured several times on China Movie Report, a program on CCTV’s movie channel, and covered by Tencent.

To learn more about Zhen Shen or how spatial audio is produced, or to discuss a collaboration, send me a private message.
